source.author: lucan
source.text: Thesproti, Dryopesque ruunt, quercusque silentes Chaonio veteres liquerunt vertice Selloe.
source.text_original: Thesproti, Dryopesque ruunt, quercusque silentes / Chaonio veteres liquerunt vertice Selloe.
source.text_english: The Thesprotians and Dryopes rush on, and the silent Selloi, ancient oaks having left the Chaonian summit, have departed.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Dodonida quercum Chaoniique vides famulam Iovis.
reuse.text_english: You see the Dodonaean oak, servant of Chaonian Jove.
